newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank says 6-mo M3 7.7 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank says 6-mo M3 7.7 pct in February.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday that extended M3 money supply grew by 6.5 percent on an annualised basis over the six months to January.
The central bank also said that M3 growth over six months was 7.7 percent in February versus 8.6 percent in January.
Six month bank lending to the private sector was up 8.2 percent in February versus 7.6 percent and six month monetary capital formation rose 5.1 percent versus 4.3 percent in January.
